channel.title: Pocket Goblin
channel.description: Updates for Pocket Goblin, the Wealth Goblin budget.

item.title: Version 1.0.0
item.description:
The first Pocket Goblin for the Mac: the Wealth Goblin budget, living in your menu bar. Free, with no account.

  • One pot of spending money for the week, shaped like a real week, so weekends get more.
  • Come in under today and the difference is paid forward to the days left, as an exact amount per day.
  • Log a spend from anywhere with a shortcut: type `180 coffee` and press Return.
  • An evening nudge to close the day, if you want one.
  • Pounds, dollars or baht, one currency per budget.
  • Updates arrive here. Settings has a Check for updates button, and nothing installs until you say so.
